title: Good Tread Does Not Automatically Make an Ohio Used Tire Installable
topic: Ohio used-tire safety criteria go beyond tread depth
mechanicTruth: Ohio law prohibits suppliers from installing used passenger tires that meet statutory unsafe-used-tire criteria, and those criteria include more than tread depth, including certain structural damage and improper repair conditions.

sourceNotes.label: Ohio Revised Code 1345.022
sourceNotes.supports: Ohio law prohibits suppliers from installing used passenger tires that meet statutory unsafe-used-tire criteria, and those criteria include more than tread depth, including certain structural damage and improper repair conditions.
